name: Reflect XR
summary:
**Explore yourself through art, reflection, and immersive VR.**
 
ReflectXR brings creative expression and meaningful reflection into an immersive virtual world. Inspired by art therapy and informed by clinically grounded concepts, ReflectXR offers engaging creative experiences designed to give you space to slow down, express yourself, explore your emotions, and discover new perspectives.
